notes.title: Blackhill Keep Playtest Available Now!
notes.notes:
[p]Hello everyone,[/p][p][/p][p]After many months of work (and a little procrastination) I'm finally proud to announce that [b]the Steam Playtest for Blackhill Keep: Heir of the Night is up right now![/b][/p][p][/p][p]The demo I'm working on is in a pre-alpha stage, so not all content will be available at the moment for playtesters. Right now, roughly half of the demo area is available, with the other half being in development (actually, if you really want to, you might be able to go out of bounds and see a sneak peek if you try hard enough).[/p][p][/p][p]At this point in development it's crucial to receive feedback on the game mechanics and the experience overall. So if you wish to join the playtest, please do so and [b]please fill the feedback survey after playing[/b]. The survey is available at any point during the game by pressing the "Give Feedback" button in the pause menu (Esc) and it's really important to aid in developing the game :)[/p][p][/p][p]If you want to follow development, be sure to follow me on my socials, and join the Discord server if you want!

[url="https://discord.gg/BPr2t867vZ"]Discord Server[/url][/p][p][url="https://bsky.app/profile/aureamorum.bsky.social"]Bluesky[/url][/p][p][url="https://x.com/aureamorum"]X/Twitter[/url][/p][p][/p][p]That's all for now, bye![/p]
